title: Entity Identity Graph: a plain-language overview (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Entity Identity Graph does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature identity method weaves every mention into a stamped graph: each link between two mentions carries its evidence, and each identity carries its full history. t: How the Entity Identity Graph works (Signature)
title: How the Entity Identity Graph works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Entity Identity Graph does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach builds the graph deterministically: fixed edge-weight rules, fixed component thresholds — the same mentions always yield the same identities. Every edge carries its evidence ledger entry (shared email, identifier match, fuzzy name at similarity X), so any identity can be audited link by link. Component splits and merges append to an identity-history ledger; the graph's past is never rewritten. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
